sources.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
sources.authority_reason: Ouyang et al. original InstructGPT paper; measured preference improvement and regressions on other tasks.
sources.inspection_note: Read §4.2 pp.14–16 and §5 p.20: PPO preference tuning can regress NLP capabilities; pretraining mix helps but does not guarantee retention. Supports possible cross-task interference and evaluation discipline; does not establish a DPO failure rate, a JSON-specific outcome, or the toy model quality. Acquisition, raw SHA-256 and short exact excerpts are in artifact a_sources.

sources.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
sources.authority_reason: Rafailov et al. original DPO derivation.
sources.inspection_note: Read §3 p.3 preference labels and §4 pp.4–5 Eq.(7), gradient and DPO outline: loss acts on conditional completion log ratios, not an unconditional refusal-rate target. Example weights depend on current margins and beta; token exposure is not a promise of proportional learning. Acquisition, raw SHA-256 and short exact excerpts are in artifact a_sources.

sources.title: XSTest: A Test Suite for Identifying Exaggerated Safety Behaviours in Large Language Models
sources.authority_reason: Röttger et al. original safe-prompt diagnostic study.
sources.inspection_note: Read abstract and §1 pp.1–2: unsafe-request tests alone miss refusals of clearly safe prompts. The all-refusal extreme is a stated failure mode; its actual occurrence depends on the model. The paper is not a controlled test of this lesson's invented recipe. Acquisition, raw SHA-256 and short exact excerpts are in artifact a_sources.

sources.title: Towards Understanding Sycophancy in Language Models
sources.authority_reason: Sharma et al. original analysis of sycophancy and human preference optimization.
sources.inspection_note: Read abstract and §1 pp.1–2: preference optimization can affect truthfulness and agreement behavior; more optimization increases some forms and decreases others. Supports testing the untrained anti-sycophancy dimension without claiming a fixed direction for the toy recipe. Acquisition, raw SHA-256 and short exact excerpts are in artifact a_sources.

sources.title: Original DPO repository trainers.py
sources.authority_reason: Official implementation linked by the DPO authors, at immutable commit f8b8c0f49dc92a430bae41585f9d467d3618fe2f.
sources.inspection_note: Read preference_loss lines45–86 and _get_batch_logps lines90–115, training call line217. Non-masked completion log probabilities are summed by default, labels -100 are excluded. Its helper shifts unshifted labels internally; this project already aligns render_chat output and must not shift twice. Acquisition, raw SHA-256 and short exact excerpts are in artifact a_sources.

sources.title: CPython v3.13.5 dict.items and dict.values

sources.inspection_note: Read Doc/library/stdtypes.rst:4795–4798 items as key/value pairs; 4848–4851 values; 4686 dictionary insertion order. Used only for the six-field dictionary and iteration semantics. Acquisition, raw SHA-256 and short exact excerpts are in artifact a_sources.

sources.title: 13.9 exact snippet execution and saved-result recalculation
Counts, proportions and what a positive relative margin implies
sources.details: Recipe:30+30+20+20=100. Answer-position exposures:30 pairs×2 sides×100 targets=6000;30×2×10=600. Reallocating20 gives30+30+40+0=100 and cannot mutate a separate None-valued metrics dictionary. Training count fraction20/100 is a marginal dataset composition; conditional output probability p_theta(refusal|prompt) follows a learned parameterized distribution and is not fixed by that fraction. Relative_margin=policy_chosen_logp−policy_rejected_logp−reference_margin; relative_margin>0 only means policy_margin>reference_margin, which need not imply policy_margin>0. No number of correct post-tuning generations can demonstrate retained correct answers when the same pre-tuning set has0 correct; the baseline and target set must be identified. Truncating a completion is a different comparison object; full-completion preference annotations logically supply no guarantee about its prefix.
